svg.title: VideoTube (In progress): Backend for a YouTube-like platform. Done: JWT auth with refresh tokens, Cloudinary uploads, channel stats and watch history via MongoDB aggregation. Video, comment and playlist endpoints are stubs. Express · MongoDB · Cloudinary.
